files.README.md:
# Harrowgate Outfitters - distribution centre

employee_roster.csv lists the centre's staff with the department each
person is assigned to. pick_log_june_2026.csv records, per person, the
units picked and the hours spent on the floor for June 2026, keyed by
employee id.

Picking is paid per unit. The hours figure reported for a department for
a month is the average hours per worker, taken over the workers of that
department who have an hours figure for the month.
